title: HTTP attack surface mapping (apps/APIs)
description: Enumerate endpoints, params, auth, and tech across web targets.
detail: 1) Fingerprint (httpx/whatweb). 2) Crawl allowed paths (katana/gau where in scope) + robots/sitemap/js. 3) Discover APIs (swagger/openapi, graphql, common /api/ patterns). 4) Identify auth boundaries, roles, ID patterns. 5) Feed to web-exploitation/api-security/auth-testing/graphql-api/ssrf-metadata skills. 6) Track each endpoint/param as asset/fact; avoid duplicate testing via graph recall.
